crossRefs.note: For my people have forgotten me. They have burned incense to false gods. They have been made to stumble in their ways…
Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders…

“Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.
“But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’
“You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify…
For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind…

that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.

to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.

“As for the word that you have spoken to us in Yahweh’s name, we will not listen to you.
But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

translations.web: Yahweh says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’
translations.bsb: This is what the LORD says: “Stand at the crossroads and look. Ask for the ancient paths: ‘Where is the good way?’ Then walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it!’
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk
translations.asv: Thus saith Jehovah, Stand ye in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way; and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls: but they said, We will not walk therein.
